5 : Sri Sabin Das

 Resident Of Village Pub Majirgaon
 Po Bhattapara
 Ps Azara
 Dist Kamrup (M) Assam
 78101
Advocate for the Petitioner : Mr. B D Konwar Sr. Adv.
Advocate for the Respondent : Ga, Assam
 Before
 Honourable Mr. Justice Manish Choudhury
 Order

Date : 17.03.2023 Heard Mr. B.D. Konwar, learned Senior Counsel assisted by Mr. P. Doley, learned counsel for the petitioners; Ms. N. Bordoloi, learned Standing Counsel, Revenue Department for the respondent no. 1; Mr. B.J. Talukdar, learned State Counsel, Assam for the respondent nos. 2 - 4; and Mr. T. Kalita, learned counsel for the respondent no. 5.

The subject-matter of this writ petition is requisitioned followed by acquisition under Section 6[1] of the Assam Land [Requisition and Acquisition] Act, 1964 a plot of land measuring 5 bighas, out of a plot of land measuring 8 bighas 3 lessas, covered by Dag no. 1848 and Patta no. 803, located at Village - Majir Gaon, Azara Revenue Circle for the purpose of construction of a new terminal building for development of LGBI Airport.

The petitioners have made claims for compensation amount in respect of a part of 5 bighas, measuring 2 bighas 10 lessas, and the respondent on. 5 has,
on the other hand, contended that there are 15 pattadars under Dag no. 1848 and Patta no. 803 and their respective shares have not yet been determined for apportionment of the compensation amounts, if any, awarded during the acquisition proceedings of L.A. Case no. 4/2018.

Having seen the nature of contentions raised by the learned contesting parties, it appears necessary to obtain instructions through Mr. Talukdar, learned State Counsel, Assam, as to whether any Award has been passed in connection with L.A. Case no. 4/2018 till date.
If so, a copy of the Award be placed before the Court on the next date of listing.
